references.context: Commutative algebra: kernel ideal of a unital homomorphism φ:A→B of commutative rings, consisting of all a∈A mapped to 0_B; for a polynomial evaluation map it is the ideal of polynomial relations, and for a quotient-localization composite it is the inverse image of zero in the target ring.
references.matching_note: This is the ring-homomorphism kernel ideal, rather than the categorical kernel of an arbitrary morphism, an unrelated module kernel, or the full evaluation map.
